title: Kononenkogroup offices
description: A services statement in big serif with the first line indented by a column, then a hairline table of offices on the 15-column grid: name in ink, place and address in grey, a thin arrow at the row's end; on phones place and address stack. The statement rises line by line; each row rises as its hairline draws in from the left.
notes: rows with an href become links (hover dims them); CSS only, the reveals are scroll-driven
